prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup. Refine the SINGLE attached Ascend Studio mockup.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve the entire existing screen, its three-column geometry, logo and breadcrumb, dense project/task navigation, exact typography, compact list spacing, chat content, right-aligned user bubble, AI answer as plain text without bubble or avatar, code/evidence canvas objects and every control. Image 2 is COLOR AND MATERIAL REFERENCE only: bright pale multi-color gradients in clear translucent glass/film, softly refracted daylight. Do not copy its marketing layout, spheres, bag, panels or text.
Target image dimensions 1672 x 941, same landscape ratio as image 1. Current date anchor 2026-10-09; do not introduce dates or new labels.

Requested change: The user likes the light colorful abstract direction but wants DIFFERENT SHAPES SUITED TO THEIR LOCATION, not one identical wavy sculptural motif stamped everywhere. Change ONLY the decorative artwork and its localized light spill. Keep a shared material language and coordinated pale cyan, lavender, rose, coral/apricot, buttery yellow and mint gradients. These colors remain clearly chromatic rather than gray. The UI stays warm white, light gray and charcoal, with neutral selected rows.

Design exactly these THREE distinctly shaped accents:
A. Sidebar bottom: A SMALL COMPACT ANGULAR FOLD. A delicate asymmetrical folded translucent film, 2 or 3 crisp tapered facets, like a tiny abstract sculptural corner flourish. Short, stable, fan-shaped silhouette, roughly 130 x 70 pixels in the leftmost bottom whitespace BELOW the footer label, partly cropped by bottom edge. No big rolling hills or tall peaks extending up into task rows. Keep all task list spacings, groups and footer text intact.
B. Conversation top: A LONG LOW HORIZONTAL LIGHT BAND. Replace the current tall mountain-like wavy folds with a slender gently flowing prismatic band approximately 360 pixels long and 40 pixels tall in the narrow white gap beneath the conversation header and above the user message. Flat lateral movement, just one soft bend and a few delicate luminous edge lines. Cyan/lilac with rose/apricot transmitted light. No pointed folded peaks and no faceted sidebar object repeated here. Preserve the clean white behind the heading '对话', task name, new conversation button and message text. Do not increase header height or push conversation down.
C. Canvas right edge: A SINGLE TALL SMOOTH ARCED SURFACE. A thin translucent crescent-like sheet follows the outside right edge, softly cropped, narrow at its visible inner edge and broad beyond the frame. One broad smooth vertical arc, NOT repeated peaks, NOT a copy of the horizontal band and NOT a ring/circle. Height about 480 pixels, visible width about 70-95 pixels, occupying the outer empty canvas margin only. Gentle rose-to-apricot-to-cyan transmission, diffuse soft edge refraction. Keep the code/evidence cards, canvas content, toolbar, mini map and zoom controls completely unobscured.

Unify optical thinness, lighting and gradient harmony, while giving each position its own silhouette, scale, direction and crop. Sophisticated editorial craftsmanship, restrained art coverage and exquisite material detail. No sphere, pearl, gemstone, jewelry, literal chip, cube, tensor grid, node, graph, chart, tick or functional mark. Decoration must not resemble an operable UI component. No full-page rainbow wash, no colored body text backgrounds, no new features, no avatar, no learning center, no altered branding. Output one polished revised screen only, no collage, concept title or option numbers.
